observations: Photo 0 and Photo 1 show the same engine from slightly different angles, placed on a concrete floor among other engines.
The engine has a silver valve cover with a barcode sticker and some text below it, but the text is too blurry to read.
There is a black plastic cover over part of the engine, possibly a timing cover or intake manifold.
The engine appears to be a 4-cylinder inline engine, with visible pulleys, belts, and various hoses and connectors.
The engine is dirty and shows signs of use, with oil residue and grime on the components.
No visible branding or model name is legible on the engine block or components in either photo.
The watermark 'UDEMEX LIMITED POSTED ON JIJI' is present on both photos.
